description: Free. Every pump.fun launch after a moment in the last 24 hours, oldest first: each with its deployer's record before it (launches, graduations, seconds since its last launch) and the first-10-second bundle. Beside `launches` comes `prices[i]` in the same order: [market_cap_sol, market_cap_usd, price_sol, venue], and `buy_page`: the launch's buy page as a template (substitute the launch's mint, where a person signs with their own wallet); the price is its own last bonding-curve or PumpSwap trade (within 10 s) from the live read, which holds coins traded in the last 12 hours, null for the rest (their price: quote_coin or /price). Launches newer than the hourly fill come within the minute (source live, bundle not yet read). For: what launched just now, new coins from devs with a record, watch new launches. Poll with t = next_since; call quote_coin or check_coin only for the coins worth a look.

check.description: true: each launch also gets checks[i]: the first 10 seconds' buy share, whether the deployer has sold, same-ticker launches in the hour, market cap now

min_launches.description: only launches by deployers with this many launches before (e.g. 20: the serial deployers)

t.description: unix seconds, within the last 24 hours; launches after it are listed. Left out: the last ten minutes

name: launches_since
